content:
Jules: FYI — we're changing the BYOK oncall authorization lifecycle tomorrow 2026-05-01 12:00 UTC. Need sign-off on RBAC deltas + audit fields we ship.
Asha: Proposal: split byok_operator -> byok_session and byok_witness. Only byok_witness can approve ephemeral unwrap. byok_session gets JIT for 1hr.
Tom: +1. Does this break existing KMS proxies? We need a transparent fallback for older tenants.
Marta: We need to include these fields in audit logs: operator_id, role_label, session_nonce, attestation_blob_sha256, kms_request_id. Also add a diff for log schema.
Jules: Agree. Plan: add hook in proxy that POSTs approval payload to approval-webhook v2. Example payload: ```{
  "operator_id": "jules",
  "session_nonce": "abc123",
  "action": "unwrap",
  "attestation": "BASE64..."
}```
Asha: Where is the attestation coming from? HSM will sign an attested statement? We should require mTLS between proxy and approval-webhook.
Tom: KMS integration note: we should rotate the service token used for approval-webhook every 24h and store the previous key for 7 days to allow replay checks.
deploy-bot: approval-webhook:v2 deployed to staging — https://staging.api.redwood/approval-webhook (ping @eng-oncall) :rocket:
Marta: For vuln triage: if approval-webhook returns 5xx, proxy should enter 'deny-closed' mode and raise incident. On 4xx treat as denied but log for RM.
Jules: For incident response, create a small runbook: 1) snapshot last 1h of kube logs, 2) export approval webhook audit entries, 3) rotate the webhook secret, 4) notify legal if PII involved.
Asha: Small ask — add a per-tenant rate limiter and a counter in audit to detect possible credential stuffing. Use field `approval_attempts_window`.
Tom: I'll file a PR for RBAC role changes and KMS token rotation. ETA EOD. Assigning to @Marta for audit pipeline changes.
Jules: Thanks. Action items: Tom -> PR for RBAC & token rotation, Marta -> add audit fields + retention policy (90 days for approval events), Asha -> review mTLS policy, me -> draft runbook. Ping me if anything blocks
